title: Product Knowledge Assessment
description: Test your ability to match customer problems to the right product features

scenarios.customerSays: We have 50 stores and need to track inventory in real time across all locations. When someone sells in Chicago, New York should know instantly.
scenarios.question: Which feature solves this?

options.text: The Inventory Dashboard with real-time sync enabled. Updates across all stores in <2 seconds.
options.feedback: ✓ Perfect! This is the exact use case for our real-time inventory feature. You matched the customer need to the perfect solution.

options.text: The standard Inventory module. It updates once per day.
options.feedback: ⚠️ The standard module exists, but this customer needs REAL-TIME updates. Recommend the Inventory Dashboard with sync instead - it's what they actually need.

options.text: We don't have a solution for that.
options.feedback: ❌ We DO! This is exactly what our Inventory Dashboard with real-time sync does. Know your features to serve customers better.

scenarios.customerSays: Our CFO needs monthly reports on sales by region, product category, and sales rep. But she wants it customized to our specific metrics.
scenarios.question: What do you recommend?

options.text: Use the Report Builder - she can create any custom report, save templates, and schedule automatic delivery.
options.feedback: ✓ Excellent! The Report Builder is exactly for custom, one-off reporting needs. She's empowered to create what she wants.

options.text: We have standard reports. She can use those.
options.feedback: ⚠️ Standard reports exist, but she asked for custom metrics. Better answer: 'Use our Report Builder - it lets you create exactly what you need.'

options.text: That's too custom. We can't help with that.
options.feedback: ❌ We absolutely can! That's exactly what the Report Builder does. Know your tools so you don't leave money on the table.

scenarios.customerSays: We sell through our website, a mobile app, and in physical stores. We need one system that tracks inventory across all channels so we don't oversell.
scenarios.question: What's the solution?

options.text: The Omnichannel Commerce Platform. It syncs inventory, orders, and customer data across all channels automatically.
options.feedback: Perfect! This is the flagship solution for multi-channel retailers. You nailed matching their complex need to our best feature.

options.text: You'll need separate systems for each channel.
options.feedback: ❌ Wrong! That's why customers come to us. Our Omnichannel Commerce Platform is designed to unify all channels. This is a missed upsell.

options.text: We have a web module and a mobile module, but stores are separate.
options.feedback: ⚠️ Those modules exist, but they don't solve the core problem (overselling across channels). The real answer is our Omnichannel Commerce Platform.

scenarios.customerSays: We use Salesforce for CRM and QuickBooks for accounting. We need our data to flow between all three systems automatically so we're not manually re-entering everything.
scenarios.question: How do you help?

options.text: Our Integration Hub connects to 500+ apps including Salesforce and QuickBooks. No manual re-entry needed.
options.feedback: ✓ Excellent! The Integration Hub is exactly for this. You showed you understand the pain point and have the perfect solution.

options.text: You'll need to manually export and import data between systems.
options.feedback: ❌ Why would you suggest manual work when we have the Integration Hub? Know your tools - it saves the customer time AND wins you the deal.

options.text: We integrate with some apps, but not those two.
options.feedback: ⚠️ Check our Integration Hub documentation - we definitely support both. Always verify before saying no. You just lost this customer.

scenarios.customerSays: Our sales team is remote and distributed. They need to see what everyone else is working on, share notes, and collaborate on deals.
scenarios.question: What solves this?

options.text: The Team Collaboration Suite. Shared workspaces, deal boards, and real-time comments so everyone knows what's happening.
options.feedback: Perfect! This is exactly what remote teams need. You matched a modern working style to the perfect feature.

options.text: They can each use their own system and update manually.
options.feedback: ❌ That defeats the purpose of collaboration. Our Team Collaboration Suite is designed for distributed teams. Recommend it!
⚠️ Email and documents exist everywhere. Our advantage is the Team Collaboration Suite - built specifically for sales team workflows. That's what to pitch.

masteryLevels.label: Product Expert 🏆
masteryLevels.description: You deeply understand our products and can match customer problems to solutions confidently. You close deals because you know what solves their pain.

masteryLevels.label: Strong Product Knowledge 💼
masteryLevels.description: You know most of our products and their use cases. Review scenarios where you scored lower to deepen your expertise.

masteryLevels.label: Building Knowledge 📈
masteryLevels.description: You're learning our product suite. Work with your manager on the scenarios you found challenging. Product knowledge = sales success.

masteryLevels.label: Product Training Needed 🎓
masteryLevels.description: Review our product documentation and ask your manager for training. You can't sell what you don't understand!
